clean_false_positive_rate.definition: clean fixtures whose live verdict is MISMATCH / clean fixtures total (strict §8.3 reading)
clean_false_positive_rate.note: Non-MATCH rate (any verdict other than MATCH) reported alongside the strict number: 0/100.

iou.definition: IoU(live OCR bbox, manifest target_region_xyxy) per fixture (§8.1)

json_schema_legality.definition: live reports passing the frozen §5 schema (scripts/validate_report_schema.py)

note: Recall, per-class recall, clean FPR and OCR CER are separate items (PROJECT_BOOK.md §8.3). CER is never a substitute for detection recall.

ocr_cer.definition: CER = (S + D + I) / N over all 300 fixtures; plain character edit distance between live OCR text and drawn text (both §4.3-normalised). Reported separately; never a recall substitute (§8.3).
ocr_cer.note: S=1 is the known live-OCR read of drawn U+FFE5 ￥ as U+00A5 ¥ on TP-S0-NUM-001 (see S0_REPORT.md §6(a) ruling); D=1 is one dropped character elsewhere. CER is an OCR-read measure, not a detection measure.

oracle_parity.definition: production vs independent Oracle on the manifest's fixed OCR line records (§8.4)

edge_battery_diagnostic.note: Diagnostic only, outside the frozen gate scope (manifest fixed records). Same 13/26 as T006, same differing cases (incl. known production defect F-01: align_lines float comparison, already routed to T013 as P1). Does not change the gate result.

recall.definition: injected character differences detected / injected character differences total (live OCR; §8.3)

recall_per_class.definition: same as recall, split by injected-error class (§8.3)

omission.note: 71 injected chars: TP-S0-ZH-003 omits two characters ("20"); all other omission fixtures omit one.

TP-S0-NUM-001.note: Live OCR reads drawn ￥ (U+FFE5) as ¥ (U+00A5): one extra SUBSTITUTION on the live path. The injected NUMERIC_CHANGE is present with the exact §8.1 fragment and span. Fixed-record path yields exactly one NUMERIC_CHANGE, per the S0 ruling (S0_REPORT.md §6(a), S0_MAINCHAT_VERDICT.md).

s0_fixture_timing_seconds.note: 1200x480 fixtures, OCR+compare per image, single warmed adapter. This is NOT the §8.3 runtime threshold (1920x1080); see PERFORMANCE_REPORT.md.
